title: Warning Against False Teachers, Christ Jesus Came to Save Sinners

questions.question: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,"

questions.question: Paul writes to Timothy, his true ____ in the faith.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:2 (ESV): "To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord."

questions.question: Paul urged Timothy to remain at ____ so that he may charge certain persons not to teach any different doctrine.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:3 (ESV): "As I urged you when I was going to Macedonia, remain at Ephesus so that you may charge certain persons not to teach any different doctrine,"

questions.question: Timothy is to charge them not to devote themselves to myths and endless ____, which promote speculations rather than the stewardship from God that is by faith.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:4 (ESV): "nor to devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculations rather than the stewardship from God that is by faith."

questions.question: The aim of our charge is love that issues from a ____ heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:5 (ESV): "The aim of our charge is love that issues from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith."

questions.question: Certain persons have wandered away into vain ____, desiring to be teachers of the law.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:6-7 (ESV): "Certain persons, by swerving from these, have wandered away into vain discussion, desiring to be teachers of the law..."

questions.question: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:8 (ESV): "Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it lawfully,"

questions.question: Understanding this, that the law is not laid down for the just but for the ____ and disobedient.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:9 (ESV): "understanding this, that the law is not laid down for the just but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and sinners..."

questions.question: I thank him who has given me strength, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he judged me ____, appointing me to his service,
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:12 (ESV): "I thank him who has given me strength, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he judged me faithful, appointing me to his service,"

questions.question: Though formerly Paul was a blasphemer, persecutor, and ____ opponent.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:13 (ESV): "though formerly I was a blasphemer, persecutor, and insolent opponent. But I received mercy because I had acted ignorantly in unbelief,"

questions.question: The saying is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to ____ sinners, of whom I am the foremost.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:15 (ESV): "The saying is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the foremost."

questions.question: Paul received mercy so that in him, as the foremost, Jesus Christ might display his perfect ____ as an example to those who were to believe.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:16 (ESV): "But I received mercy for this reason, that in me, as the foremost, Jesus Christ might display his perfect patience as an example to those who were to believe in him for eternal life."

questions.question: To the King of the ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and ____ forever and ever. Amen.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:17 (ESV): "To the King of the ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen."

questions.question: By rejecting conscience, certain persons have made ____ of their faith.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:19 (ESV): "holding faith and a good conscience. By rejecting this, some have made shipwreck of their faith,"

questions.question: Among those who made shipwreck of their faith are Hymenaeus and ____, whom Paul handed over to Satan that they may learn not to blaspheme.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 1:20 (ESV): "among whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan that they may learn not to blaspheme."

key_verse_text: The saying is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the foremost.
